the effect of the applied magnetic field and body acceleration on the flow of blood in the artery.
the influence of the magnetic field on the flow of blood in tapered artery with mild stenosis.

a mathematical model of electro hydrodynamic (EHD) flow of non-Newtonian Jeffrey fluid through tapered artery with mild arterial stenosis under the influence of applied magnetic field and body acceleration.
